quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Road hazard sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow (orange in work areas). They warn you about hazards ahead or areas where special rules apply.

questions.question: When may you pass another vehicle?

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because few vehicles are coming.
By using the shoulder of the highway.
When your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill or in a curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the highway shoulder. Never pass over a solid yellow line.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distances and crash severity.
questions.correctAnswerText: High speeds
questions.explanation: High speeds greatly increase stopping distances and crash severity. The faster you drive, the harder your vehicle hits in a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: Unless posted otherwise, what is the speed limit in cities and towns?
questions.correctAnswerText: 35 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in cities and towns is 35 mph unless a different speed limit is posted. Follow any posted speed limit signs.

questions.question: How do you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, yield to traffic, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must yield to you.
Drive slowly so you can check traffic.
Always come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, yield to traffic, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging onto a freeway, signal and enter at the same speed as traffic. Always yield to other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: A fire engine is following your vehicle on a two-lane street with no emergency signals on. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to drive normally.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is behind you with no siren or lights on, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to make a U-turn. Do not turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What is the "No zone"?

options.text: A term used to describe blind spots around a truck or bus.
A roadway with restrictions on vehicle stereo volume.
The television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: A term used to describe blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on the sides, back, and front. Cars cannot be seen in these blind spots. These areas are called the "No zone."

questions.question: Why does driving at night require more caution?

options.text: There is more traffic at night.
Drivers cannot see as well at night.
Accidents happen more often at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers cannot see as well at night.
questions.explanation: It is dark at night, so drivers cannot see as well as they can during the day. You must use your headlights from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise, or when people and vehicles cannot be seen from 500 feet away.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: May be safely held by a strong adult.
Will be safe if they are standing on the floor in the back of the vehicle.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Use special child seats for small children. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always use a proper seat to keep children safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: When you are following traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto the tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing tracks.

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Looks out for the actions of other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Looks out for the actions of other drivers.
questions.explanation: Even experienced drivers get distracted. A defensive driver watches what other drivers do and prepares for problems before they happen.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: When you turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, your car should be in:

options.text: The right lane of the street.
The left lane of the street.
The lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane of the street.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, complete the turn into the lane closest to where you came from.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you approach an unmarked railroad crossing. Look and listen for trains from both directions before you cross. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance from the tracks. Wait until the train passes before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed for leaving a highway.
The safe speed for entering a highway.
The safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for leaving a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does a "No standing" sign mean?

options.text: You can never stop your vehicle there.
You can park there if the driver stays in the car.
You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
You can stop to load or unload goods.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
questions.explanation: A "No standing" sign means you can only stop for a short time to pick up or drop off passengers.

questions.question: What does an octagonal sign always mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: Octagonal signs are always stop signs. Come to a complete stop when you see a red, eight-sided sign.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: The same as a stop sign.
You don't have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Keep going through the intersection normally.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and go when the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "be careful." Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: What should you do before changing lanes on a highway?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Look in your rearview and side mirrors to make sure no one is passing you. Also look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. You must:

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the other vehicle at least half of the road space.
Tell the other vehicle to pull over.
Turn on your high beams so they see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the other vehicle at least half of the road space.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give oncoming vehicles at least half of the road space. Both drivers need enough space to pass each other safely.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to pedestrians:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
Only when they are in a crosswalk.
Only if they are on your side of the road.
If they signal you to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always yield to pedestrians in the street. This is true even if they are crossing against the light or being careless.

questions.question: Which substances can impair your driving and lead to a DUI arrest?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving. These include all types of alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and many legal medicines (prescription and over-the-counter).

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.correctAnswerText: Octagon.
questions.explanation: Stop signs have eight sides. This shape is used only for stop signs.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other cars.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go much faster or slower than other traffic. Drive at the same speed as the flow of traffic, but not above the speed limit.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce
questions.explanation: Slow down before turning. This helps you keep control of your car, stay in your lane, and handle surprises.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road you are on ends ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
Another road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a Y intersection ahead. You will need to turn either right or left.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, other drivers must account for:

options.text: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
The shorter distance trucks need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need much more distance to stop than smaller cars. Stay where the truck driver can see you and where you can see the traffic ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Very dangerous.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is very dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Paying full attention to the road helps prevent crashes.
